exposure: excessive gestational weight gain (GWG) before 28 weeks
outcome: rate of vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC)
cohort: 512 women who attempted trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC) in a Chinese hospital between January 2016 and October 2022
finding: Excessive gestational weight gain after 28 weeks of pregnancy was associated with a lower rate of VBAC, regardless of pre-pregnancy BMI or weight gain before 28 weeks.
